description: What the Preferences window may use: showing itself once its page is styled, being dragged by its top bar, setting the app's appearance, light, dark or the system's, as the person chooses it (src/window-theme.ts), and Tauri's core defaults, which let it tell the app whether the Dock icon rotates. It has no file permissions at all: settings live in the app's local storage, and the command line is installed through the app's own install_command_line command, which needs no permission.
